corrected_value.title: When worry about climate change leads to climate action: How values, worry and personal responsibility relate to various climate actions

decisions.quote: The current study replicates and extends recent work (Bouman et al., 2020; Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022) which found a meaningful and robust relationship between people's feelings of responsibility to reduce climate change, their worry about climate change, and their belief that climate change is caused by humans. Importantly, these findings were consistently observed across 31 different European countries, and when controlling for crucial socio-demographic variables.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. Both the Introduction (line 73) and the Discussion (line 101) explicitly identify Bouman et al. (2020) alongside Syropoulos & Markowitz (2022) as the recent European cross-national work whose empirical finding—that personal responsibility to reduce climate change predicts greater worry about climate change and belief in human-caused climate change—is directly replicated using Wave 10 European Social Survey data across 31 countries. The source reference list (lines 224-230) verifies the identity of Bouman et al. (2020) ('When worry about climate change leads to climate action: How values, worry and personal responsibility relate to various climate actions', Global Environmental Change, 2020). The sole shipped row (input_row_index 1549, Syropoulos & Markowitz, 2022, 10.1016/j.jenvp.2022.101868) matches sibling target_index 0 and is a distinct paper by different authors in a different journal; report equivalence does not apply.
